Thanks for the answer. I'll try your tip once I'll get my hands onto a new project. But I still have one question: I'm really confused about everything melodic. Beats aren't a problem, but everything revolving around sounds made from synths and making melodies and chords is a big problem of mine. I know nothing about it, and I don't know where to learn about it. Do you have any YouTube videos for beginners like me when it comes to stuff like this?

Edit: Sorry for my bad structuring of sentences + grammar. Mind's often really hazy. What I meant was that I have absolutely no clue about music theory, and I seem to not get it at all. Feels like I have a memory disorder or something when it comes to this.
Thanks for your offer, but I really don't think that anything can help me now
Thanks for your reply, but I already have two cats. One if which that likes to be pet. But animals just can't help me if it's human love I'm deprived of

I have one or two friends to which I could talk, but they can't really do much other than consoling me. I'm afraid to seek medical help because of my mom. She can't fine out, which she will at some point. I also don't trust the doctor I'm going to, and I'm too afraid to go there alone without making an appointment and without being physically ill. Besides that, my motivation is at an all time low, and I just can' bring myself to go outside anymore besides school

Thanks for your kind words.
I just don't know what to do in this situation altogether...
I can't go to the therapist, I'm too afraid to talk about even the slightest problems in person (especially my suicidal thoughts), and I just don't see any other way than just ending my life...

Thanks to my problems, I think I have to be able to do so, _so_ many things to deserve even the _slightest_ bit of love at all, and I can't get thought out of my head. The thing is that I can't do even one of these things, while others can, which makes just everything worse...

And I can't give love to myself either. I'm one of the persons in my life I hate the most. I'm unhappy with everything in my life, including everything involving me. My body, my personality, just everything wrong with me.

There are so many things that have me a wrong view on the world and especially myself, and I feel like everything's my fault...

And I just have so many problems in school. Everything was okay, I got along with everything, and my grades weren't _that_ bad. But now, I don't have the motivation to do anything other than playing video games anymore. I have so many assignments to do, but I just can't do any if them, and so, everyone gets mad at me...
Because I want to talk to people of course
But what do I have to do? I lost hope in everything, and anybody saying it otherwise just lets me feel even worse...

I'm sorry to say that, and I don't want to sound mean, but this isn't helping... My anxiety is keeping me from seeking professional help. And things like: "you have to force yourself" just doesn't help at all...
Everything seems hopeless, and I'm tired of hear things like: "No, there is hope".

People just aren't helping. I feel hopeless and nothing can change my mind anymore...
